title: Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Statement, Payment and Automatic Payment Schedule

# Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Statement, Payment and Automatic Payment Schedule

**Finance desk servicing schedule.** Every statement, scheduled payment, payment channel and automatic payment condition on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan runs on the figures the plan's promotional term sets. The schedule is set out in three parts: the statement cycle, the crediting of payments, and automatic payment.

## Part A — Statement cycle

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nominal billing cycle, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Calendar days between the statement closing date and the payment due date printed on it | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Scheduled minimum payment, share of the balance at term start | 16.67 percent | 8.34 percent | 5.56 percent | 4.17 percent | 2.78 percent | 2.09 percent |
| Smallest scheduled monthly payment billed regardless of the factor | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 65.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| Smallest balance for which a statement is produced at all | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD |
| Balance at or below which a remaining amount is written off instead of billed | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 5.00 USD |
| Default statement delivery until the customer changes it | paper | paper | electronic | electronic | electronic | electronic |
| Fee per cycle for a posted paper statement | 1.99 USD | 1.99 USD | 1.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Part B — Crediting of payments

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cut-off time, Eastern time, after which a payment is credited to the next day | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 20:00 | 20:00 | 20:00 |
| Channels credited the same day when received before the cut-off | in store, online portal | in store, online portal | in store, online portal | in store, online portal, phone agent | in store, online portal, phone agent | in store, online portal, phone agent, automatic payment |
| Order in which a payment is applied across what is owed | fees then interest then principal | fees then interest then principal | fees then interest then principal | fees then interest then principal | interest then fees then principal | interest then fees then principal |
| Charge for clearing the plan early, share of the balance cleared | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |

## Part C — Automatic payment

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days before a due date by which automatic payment must be arranged to govern that payment | 5 | 5 | 5 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Calendar days after a failed automatic payment during which a replacement payment is still treated as on time | 3 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 5 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The **nominal billing cycle** is 30 calendar days on every term and the payment due date is printed 25 calendar days after the statement closing date on every term.
- The **scheduled minimum payment share** is applied to the balance at the start of the term; the **payment floor** is the smallest scheduled monthly payment the plan bills regardless of that share.
- The **paper statement fee** is charged per cycle for a posted paper statement and stands at 1.99 USD on the three deferred interest terms and at 0.00 USD on the three equal payment terms; the default delivery is paper on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan and electronic on every other term.
- The **cut-off** is 17:00 Eastern time on the three deferred interest terms and 20:00 Eastern time on the three equal payment terms.
- The **same-day channels** widen with the term: the three deferred interest terms credit in-store and online portal payments the same day; the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan add payments taken by a phone agent; the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan adds automatic payment as well.
- The **allocation order** is fees, then interest, then principal on the four shorter terms, and interest, then fees, then principal on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.
- The **prepayment charge** stands at 0 percent of the balance cleared on every term.
